Чем плагин Figma отличается от расширени: How do Figma plugins, extensions and online utilities differ?
Плагин работает с выделением в макете Fi: A plugin works with selected elements in Figma. An extension adds commands to Tilda, Taptop or a review platform. An online utility opens in a browser and processes a selected file without installation.
Как сжать изображение для сайта?: How do I compress an image for a website?
Открой сжатие WebP и SVG, добавь изображ: Open the WebP and SVG tool, add images and check the preview. For photos, you can adjust quality and download several files in an archive. SVG optimization preserves the vector format.
Сохраняется ли качество при объединении: Does merging PDFs preserve their quality?
При объединении без сжатия страницы копи: Without compression, pages are copied into the resulting document. The optional compression mode converts pages to JPEG images, so small text and fine lines may become less sharp.
Можно ли редактировать текст после импор: Can I edit text after importing a PDF into Figma?
В векторном режиме PDF → Figma переводит: PDF → Figma converts text to outlines in vector mode. You can edit paths, but cannot change words as you would in a text layer. Raster mode inserts each page as an image.
Какие отзывы собирает Reviews Exporter?: Which reviews does Reviews Exporter collect?
Отзывы организаций на Яндекс Картах, про: Business reviews on Yandex Maps, seller and residential building reviews on Avito, product reviews on Ozon, and post comments in Telegram Web. Results are saved to Markdown. Export completeness depends on available entries and sign-in requirements.
Как установить расширение в Chrome?: How do I install an extension in Chrome?
Скачай архив у автора или на странице ра: Download an archive from the author or extension page, unzip it, open chrome://extensions and enable Developer mode. Click Load unpacked and select the folder containing manifest.json. Step-by-step instructions are above.
Можно ли установить расширение в Яндекс: Can I install the extensions in Yandex Browser or Edge?
Расширения рассчитаны на браузеры Chromi: The extensions target Chromium browsers that support Manifest V3 and loading unpacked extensions. Menu names and installation restrictions depend on the browser and your organization’s settings. These builds are not intended for Safari or Firefox.
Как обновить расширение?: How do I update an extension?
Распакуй свежую версию в ту же папку, на: Unzip the latest version into the same folder, click Reload on its card in chrome://extensions and reload the editor tab. The open page will then receive the new extension code.
